svg.title: Envelopes and who pays once
svg.desc: Log-scale power axis from microwatts to gigawatts. TinyML sensors sit at the low end, GPU racks and hyperscale at the high end, and a dashed target range from 1 W to 50 kW in the middle, with dots for sensor, wearable, robot, edge server, server and rack. A second row marks published reference points: Jetson Orin Nano 7 to 25 W, typical racks 4 to 6 kW, DGX B200 14.3 kW, GB200 NVL72 rack about 120 kW, and planned 1 GW and 5 GW campuses. Below, a list of who would pay once instead of forever, and a paragraph describing the asset: a library of verified fits licensed as a commons. Opinions are labelled; references [1] to [6] at the bottom.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: Where the budget is a battery or a breaker, not a procurement contract. Today's ML deployment clusters at the two ends of the power scale; the middle
range is where this work is aimed (informed opinion).

text.tspan: [1] NVIDIA Jetson Linux Developer Guide r39.2.1, Orin power modes: Orin Nano power budgets 7 W, 10 W, 15 W, 25 W.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: [2] Uptime Institute Global Data Center Survey 2024: average rack density below 8 kW; 4 to 6 kW racks most commonly deployed.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: [3] NVIDIA DGX B200 user guide: system power ~14.3 kW max. [4] NVIDIA DGX GB rack-scale user guide: NVL72 rack ~120 kW.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: [5] Meta (M. Zuckerberg, 14 July 2025, as reported by DatacenterDynamics): Prometheus, multi-GW, online 2026; Hyperion to scale to 5 GW over several years. Plans, not measured load.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: [6] ITU Facts and Figures 2025: 74% of the world online in 2025; more than a quarter offline; 23% online in low-income countries.
